nodes.description: Address of the OpenSea ProxyRegistry used to whitelist proxy operators for gas-less listings.
Per-token mint price in wei (0.08 ETH), used in the payment requirement of minting functions.
Maximum number of tokens that may ever be minted (3555).
Merkle root of the whitelist used to verify wlMint proofs.
Boolean flag that enables the whitelist mint phase.
Boolean flag that enables the public mint phase.
CountersUpgradeable.Counter tracking the next token id to be minted.
Empty constructor guarded by the initializer modifier (oz-upgrades-unsafe-allow constructor) to lock the implementation contract.
Initializer that sets up ERC721 metadata, configures proxy registry, basePrice, _totalSupply and the token counter.
Payable whitelist mint: checks phase flag, count limit, payment, Merkle proof of msg.sender, then mints via _safeMint in a loop.
Payable public mint: checks public flag, count limit and payment, then mints via _safeMint in a loop.
onlyOwner setter that replaces the whitelist merkle root.
onlyOwner toggle that enables the whitelist mint phase.
onlyOwner toggle that enables the public mint phase.
Overrides ERC721 approval lookup to also trust the caller's OpenSea proxy contract from the registry.
View helper returning the current value of the token id counter.
Pausable hook invoked before every mint/transfer/burn; gated by whenNotPaused.
UUPS upgrade authorization hook restricted to onlyOwner.
Withdraws the whole contract balance with an unchecked low-level send to owner().
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, Merkle leaf and access-control subject.
External callback to IERC721ReceiverUpgradeable.onERC721Received triggered by _safeMint; enables reentrancy into minting state.
Unchecked payable(owner()).send(amount) low-level value call performed in withdrawAll.
basePrice * count multiplication used in the msg.value payment requirement of the mint functions.
Number of tokens the caller asks to mint in wlMint; bounds-checked to <= 10.
Merkle proof supplied by the caller for the whitelist check.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender)) leaf verified against merkleRoot.
Token id read from the counter inside the wlMint loop before being minted.
Number of tokens the caller asks to mint in batchMint; bounds-checked to <= 10.
Token id read from the counter inside the batchMint loop before being minted.
Hard-coded OpenSea proxy registry address assigned to proxyRegistryAddress during initialize.
Owner whose OpenSea proxy is looked up in isApprovedForAll.
Operator address compared against the owner's registered proxy.
Cached contract balance forwarded by the unchecked send in withdrawAll.
New merkle root supplied by the owner to setMerkleRoot.
Counter value read and returned by currentToken.
Address of the new implementation passed to the UUPS upgrade authorization hook.
